name: simplePrepayment

testSteps.description: Given that im logged into prepayments page

children.description: When i open page from sidebar menu: {Accounts Payable,Voucher Entries,Prepayment}

testSteps.description: Then the prepayment page and its contents should show up
When I set the 'Invoice Number' to 'cFau8lXFtT'
Then the payment amount form should show up
When i select the first bank account and click submit button if modal exist
When I set the 'Gross Amount' to '10000'
Then the prepayment successfully created modal and its contents should show up

title: Simple prepayment
